findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment: 2-102.12: (A) Observed PIC to not have current certified food manager certification. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed glass plated to be stored on the bottom shelf of a prep table in a cardboard box. The box was removed. All non food contact surfaces shall be non absorbent, smooth and washable. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed one of the containers of spoons at the prep table to have some dust and crumbs in the bottom. The spoons and container were put to be washed. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: The ice machine has some soil on the side and the fire supression nozzels have some soil/dust build up. Clane and manintain free of accumulated soil. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use and any time they may have become contamintaed.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed cutting board at the prep table to have scores and rough areas. 750-650a Food contact surfaces shall be smooth, non absorbent, easily cleanable, and free of breaks, open seams, cracks, chips, pits, and free of difficult-to-clean internal corners and crevices. Provide smooth cleanable cutting board.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed cardboard boxes used at the dressing area and at the stove to hold hot mits. 750-690 Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition. The boxes were discarded and new methods of storage employed.

findings.title: Dishwashing facilities designed, constructed, operated (1. wash 2. rinse 3. sanitize)
findings.comment: Observed the bar 3 part set up as wash, sanitize rinse. 750-820d Equipment and utensil cleaning shall be conducted as a sequence of wash, rinse and sanitize. The sink was remade.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
750.800b - Mold accumulation was observed inside both ice machines.

Clean and sanitize inside ice machines as needed to eliminate buildup of mold and/or lime.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.citation_text:
750.1060 - Leak was observed at the plumbing under the kitchen handsink. Repair the plumbing under the kitchen handsink.

All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. 
NOTE: A bucket was placed under the kitchen handsink to catch leaking water until proper repairs can be made. Owner was advised to empty the bucket throughout the day/at the close of operations daily.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - Quat test kit was not available for checking solutions made with Steramine tablets at bar 3 part sink. Quat strips were purchased during the inspection.

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentrations of each chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solutions in parts per million.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.citation_text:
750.510 - Employee was observed putting on gloves prior to washing hands. Employee removed gloves to wash hands and was then observed washing hands without proper technique (manual faucet shut off without paper towel as barrier). Proper handwashing and when to wash hands were discussed with employee. 
Educational handouts on handwashing and glove use were provided.

Employees shall properly wash their hands and time hands may have been contaminated, before putting on gloves/between glove changes, and before working with food, clean equipment, or unwrapped single service articles.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
750.830g - Quat test kit at bar was water damaged and had to be discarded. Spare quat test kit was not available. Purchase more test strips and store test kits in an area protected from potential water damage.

A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of each chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solutions in parts per million.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.citation_text:
750.860 - A) Utensil and bowl storage containers had debris accumulation in the bottom. Clean storage containers as needed and maintain clean. 

B) Clean pitchers were observed under plumbing beneath sink at drink counter. Do not store clean equipment directly beneath and/or near plumbing.

Cleaned and sanitized utensils/equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text:
750.1200 & 1220 - Gap was observed in the corner of dry storage room where walkin freezer wall is in contact with inner wall behind storage shelves. Baseboard was missing from one section behind the storage shelves, and a gap was present between the bottom of the walkin freezer and the floor where old food, dust, and debris has accumulated over time. What appeared to be old mouse droppings were also observed in the corner where the gap was present. Owner noted the facility has not experienced any issues with rodents (have a contract with Orkin). 
Owner was advised to clean in the aforementioned areas to the best of her abilities and then properly seal the corner and the floor to wall juncture beneath the walkin freezer.

The junctures between walls and floors shall be coved and sealed, or shall not present an opening of more that 1/32 of an inch.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.citation_text:
750.140 - Au jus and meatballs cooling in walkin were not labeled with time. Labeling was discussed at length with owner, and time was placed on the pans of food. Both products were still within the 2hr time frame to reach 70F/below. Internal temperatures were high enough that ice baths were setup to help rapidly drop temperatures to 70F/below.
Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41F.
(see general comments)

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text:
750.820(d)(4) - Glasses at bar 3 part sink were not properly sanitized due to improper setup of sinks. Sinks were setup wash, sanitize, and rinse. Glasses already went through ware washing process and were off to the side air drying. Proper setup of 3 part sink was discussed with owners. Sinks were emptied to be setup wash, rinse, and sanitize so glasses could go through manual ware washing again in the correct order.
Equipment and utensils must be properly washed in the first compartment, rinsed free of detergent/abrasives with clean water in the second compartment, and sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4). Equipment and utensils must stay submerged in sanitizer solution (50-100ppm chlorine) for 60 seconds prior to air drying.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor behind and floor drain in front of rangetop oven were soiled. Food debris was observed behind the oven while some food debris and grimy buildup were noted in the floor drain (especially down inside the circular opening). Clean the floors, drains, and drain covers throughout as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.citation_text:
750.140 - Sausage and meatballs cooling in walkin were not labeled with time. Labeling was discussed with owner.
Potentially hazardous food shall be labeled or tagged with date and time of preparation and rapidly cooled to an internal temperature of 41F.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 750.800b - The following food contact surfaces were soiled with buildup of food debris: A) slicer (back side of blade) & B) can opener blade. Properly clean and sanitize food contact surfaces between uses/as needed to prevent cross contamination and eliminate buildup of debris. In-use utensils and equipment, such as the slicer and can opener, must go through ware washing process up to every 4hrs.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.citation_text:
750.1110 & 1120 - A) New restroom doors do not have self-closers. Install self-closers on new restroom doors.
B) New restrooms do not have covered waste cans. Provide covered waste cans in new restrooms.
Easily cleanable, covered waste receptacles shall be provided for waste storage. All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.
